full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 40
Federal
Nepal
Daily Agenda
Parliament
Tuesday, Bhadra 9, 2082
1:00 PM
(Tentative)
Management Work
Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sovita Gautam:
1. a) To present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Nepal Law Commission (First Amendment) Bill, 2082".
b) To introduce the "Nepal Law Commission (First Amendment) Bill, 2082".
2. Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sovita Gautam, to present a proposal to consider the "Mediation (Second Amendment) Bill, 2082".
3. Honorable Minister for Youth, Labour and Employment, Ramji Yadav, to present a proposal to send the "Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Bill, 2082" to the relevant committee for clause-by-clause discussion.
Treaty Related Work
4. Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sovita Gautam, to present the "Agreement on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biological Diversity of Areas Beyond National Jurisdiction under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Management Work
sections.summary_en: The Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs sought permission to introduce the Nepal Law Commission (First Amendment) Bill, 2082, and then introduced it. The Minister also presented a proposal for consideration of the Mediation (Second Amendment) Bill, 2082. The Minister for Youth, Labour and Employment proposed sending the Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Bill, 2082 to a committee for clause-by-clause discussion.
